Definition: from G1909 and G5158 (in the sense of G2011); a commissioner, i.e. domestic manager, guardian:--steward, tutor.
BiblicalUsage: The word epítropos covers a commissioner. Across Matthew, Luke, and Galatians it keeps the same plain meaning. It is a small word, and its few uses are each worth the look.
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced epítropos is worth knowing, because the passages above lean on it. It is a small word with a steady job, and I trust it to do that job.
